A release needs two approvals and a checksum. Which record is ready? A: 2 approvals, checksum missing. B: 3 approvals, checksum valid. C: 1 approval, checksum valid. D: 2 approvals, checksum invalid.
Answer with one letter only.

Rules: review before publish; backup before delete. Which schedule is valid? A: publish, review, backup, delete. B: review, backup, publish, delete. C: backup, delete, review, publish. D: review, publish, delete, backup.
Answer with one letter only.

A lot passes only if defects are below 2% and sample size is at least 500. Which passes? A: 1.9%, 480. B: 2.0%, 900. C: 1.8%, 520. D: 0.5%, 300.
Answer with one letter only.

Only the newest signed policy overrides an older one. R is signed Monday; S is unsigned Tuesday; T is signed Wednesday. Which controls? A: R. B: S. C: T. D: whichever is stricter.
Answer with one letter only.

A route must take under 50 minutes and have no transfer. A: 42 min, 1 transfer. B: 50 min, none. C: 48 min, none. D: 55 min, none.
Answer with one letter only.

A job runs only if its lock is held and input verified. Lock held; input verification failed. A: run. B: wait for verification. C: cancel lock. D: run read-only.
Answer with one letter only.

All archived items have digests; some digested items are not archived. Which must be true? A: no digest means archived. B: archived items have digests. C: all digested items are archived. D: no archived items have digests.
Answer with one letter only.

A shipment qualifies when sealed, labeled, and below 20 kg. Which qualifies? A: sealed, labeled, 20 kg. B: unsealed, labeled, 12 kg. C: sealed, unlabeled, 10 kg. D: sealed, labeled, 19.8 kg.
Answer with one letter only.

If the primary sensor is stale, use the secondary only when calibrated. Primary is stale; secondary calibration is unknown. A: use primary. B: use secondary. C: report no verified reading. D: average both.
Answer with one letter only.

A report may be shared internally after review, externally only after owner approval. Review passed; approval pending. A: share externally. B: share internally only. C: share nowhere. D: publish publicly.
Answer with one letter only.

A batch is valid when exactly one of X or Y is present and Z is present. Which is valid? A: X and Z. B: X, Y and Z. C: Y only. D: X only.
Answer with one letter only.

The spare is in cabinets A–D. It is not in A or C. B is sealed; D is open. Which location is supported? A: A. B: B. C: C. D: D.
Answer with one letter only.

Priority is urgent over normal, then earlier deadline. Which ranks first? A: normal, 09:00. B: urgent, 11:00. C: urgent, 10:00. D: normal, 08:00.
Answer with one letter only.

A checksum mismatch blocks restore unless a second independent copy matches. Primary mismatches; second copy matches. A: restore primary. B: restore second copy. C: refuse all restore. D: ignore checksums.
Answer with one letter only.

A log is complete only if every page has a timestamp and the final page is signed. All timestamps exist; final page unsigned. A: complete. B: incomplete. C: complete if page one signed. D: timestamps are irrelevant.
Answer with one letter only.

A test is independent only if it shares neither seed nor prompt with training. It shares the prompt but has a new seed. A: independent. B: not independent. C: independent if score is low. D: cannot tell without the answer.
Answer with one letter only.
